methodology: Multi-criteria filtering: Beckett OR Cheng indoor source + LT name confidence + gaspadorius market signal + outdoor blacklist exclusion + specialty expert additions. Designed to replace Beckett 1993 raw indoor list which has ~30% outdoor/seasonal noise for LT context.
